bagPolicy.summary: Small to medium personal bags, purses and backpacks are permitted after a search. The FAQ does not give numeric size limits and there is no coat check.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The venue names the Ellis O’Farrell Garage at 123 O’Farrell Street, Union Square Garage at 333 Post Street and California Parking Garage at 665 Sutter Street.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue FAQ gives its 420 Mason Street address and transit stops but does not designate a rideshare pickup area.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The FAQ says food is not sold at August Hall, though drinks are available; outside food and beverages are prohibited, except an empty water bottle.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The venue is accessible; email the box office with the guest name and show for seating accommodation. ADA seating is limited to one companion per guest.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Guests age 21 or older with valid ID may step outside to smoke and re-enter; guests under 21 cannot re-enter.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Tickets can be bought online or at the 420 Mason Street box office, which opens one hour before posted doors on show nights. The FAQ does not state a separate will-call process.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The show-night box office opens one hour before the published door time. Check the event listing for the actual door time and age requirement.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
